Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, monocytosis, mild thrombocytopenia, and elevated RDW, suggesting possible infection, inflammation, or bone marrow dysfunction. Total protein is low, but albumin is normal, indicating possible hypogammaglobulinemia or protein loss. Liver and kidney function are within normal limits. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
